description: The reviewed registry mapping trusted validator IDs to commands. Annotations, manifests, and impact analysis reference IDs only and never carry executable shell text — an annotation must not be able to introduce a command. Adding an entry here is a governance change requiring review.

excluded.reason: Sends real email and mutates a live Google Workspace account. Gated by GOOGLE_LIVE_E2E and GOOGLE_LIVE_SEND_E2E. Deliberately absent from the registry so no impact analysis, agent, or automated run can select it; invoke it by hand, knowingly.

validators.description: ruff check, ruff format --check, and ty check over backend app, tests, and cli.
The backend pytest suite. Async via anyio with a mocked database session, so it needs no live services. In CI the test job runs make test-cov, a superset of this command.

Backend pytest with coverage (branch measurement on, coverage.xml emitted). The fail_under floor is a ratchet against measured coverage, not an achievement claim. This is the command the CI test job runs.
Frontend lint, type-check, and vitest with coverage under bun; the ratcheted thresholds in vitest.config.ts are enforced here, not only in CI.
prettier --check over the frontend. frontend/** is pinned to LF in .gitattributes so the check reads the same on Windows and Linux checkouts.
next build with telemetry disabled. Catches route-level, RSC-boundary, and next.config failures that tsc --noEmit does not.

pip-audit over the backend and governance-tool locks and the Docling sidecar requirements.lock (audit-python, gating in CI), then bun audit over the frontend and npm audit over the chrome-devtools sidecar (audit-js, gating in CI since 2026-08-19; a framework-pinned transitive finding is fixed through the overrides block in frontend/package.json).

The pre-commit hooks over the whole tree (ty and the governance fast check skipped: lint and governance-check already run them), actionlint and zizmor over the workflows, and hadolint at warning threshold over every Dockerfile. actionlint, hadolint and gitleaks run from pinned container images so the local and CI binaries are the same.

gitleaks over a commit range (BASE=<sha>) or the working tree and reachable history without one. CI passes the push or PR base; a full-history scan is not the gate because of the open secrets-pushed-to-remote finding.

Playwright end-to-end suite - the one validator that proves the browser-to-proxy-to-backend chain. Playwright starts the frontend itself; the backend must be up (make dev or make run locally; the CI e2e job boots it on the pgvector and redis services with LLM_PROVIDER=test). CI runs chromium only: make playwright ARGS=--project=chromium.
Validates every canonical Compose file-stack and profile combination, then re-invokes the production stack check with dummy values.
Validates the production stack with the frontend, edge, mcp, and codecov profiles. Runs in CI as the tail of compose-check.
Confirms the external preservation volumes redis-data and docling-models exist. Read-only: it never creates or normalizes them.
Probes Docker Model Runner for the embedding model at the contracted dimension and for the reranker. The health check for the model-runner-host component.
Fails when a service port is already in use on the host.
Fails when an edge port (80, 443, 8080) is already in use. Relevant to the existing IIS environment.
Confirms the MCP sidecar tokens are set and not left at their placeholder values.
Alembic upgrade, downgrade, and round-trip tests. Self-skipping without a reachable database; CI runs it against the pgvector image.
Covers the Docling parser, embedding service, reranker, retrieval, and the embedding cache-key fingerprint. The dedicated test for the embedding dimension guard.
Deterministic pydantic-evals tool-routing and approval-policy cases. No live LLM, cheap enough to run on every change touching the agent surface.

The governance tool's own suite under coverage: determinism, idempotence, golden fixtures, malformed-input handling, and the hook scripts. The fail_under floor in tools/repo_governance/pyproject.toml is a ratchet against measured coverage.
ruff check and ruff format --check over tools/repo_governance, with the tool's own ruff configuration.
Map-vs-territory spot check: samples tracked files (seeded by HEAD, so reproducible) and verifies every manifest claim about them. Nonzero on any mismatch.
Full read-only governance check: regeneration comparison, schemas, references, policies, and idempotence.

Reference integrity for the agent operating surface and the prose documentation: every path, Make target, and validator ID cited by .claude skills, commands, and rules, and by docs/, must exist. Strict by default; nonzero exit on any stale citation.
